blocks.html: Every service below is presented the same way: the problem it solves, who it is for and who it is not for, what you receive, and what changes the size of the work. Fixed prices are given after a conversation, in a written proposal.

items:
Website building

A website that's planned before it's built, then handed over with notes, so it keeps working long after launch day.

This service is not a ready-made template with new colours; every site is built from the ground up around your business.

Priced in bands, S to L, by pages, features, integrations and how ready your content is

More on website building

UI/UX design

Interfaces shaped by what your customers need to do, handed over as a system developers can actually build from.

If you only need a few screens to show investors, this service is not the right fit.

Priced in bands, S to L, by the number of flows and key screens

More on UI/UX design

Business model design

A model you can actually test: what you're assuming, how the money comes in, and how you'll know whether to keep going or stop.

Financial forecasting and investment advice are outside this service.

A fixed price per phase, in writing

More on business model design

Documentation

Documents the next person can pick up and use, with a clear reader, a set format, and a rule for keeping them current.

If the document will not be used and kept current, this service is not for you.

A fixed price per phase, in writing

More on documentation

Penetration testing

A manual test within an agreed scope, with a CVSS-scored report and one retest. You'll see what was tested, and what wasn't.

Testing runs only with the system owner's written permission, and we do not certify any system as fully secure.

A fixed price for an agreed scope, quoted only after we've talked; one retest included

More on penetration testing

Marketing and content

Video, writing and SEO planned around your product, so your content answers customers instead of just decorating the page.

We do not guarantee a specific Google ranking, and no committed provider can.

A monthly band, by number of pieces, channels and SEO work

More on marketing and content
